guideline: Human evaluators answered yes/no questions on three aspects: (1) whether filtered episodic knowledge is relevant to the sample, (2) whether filtered redundant content does not contain required knowledge, and (3) whether generated discourse knowledge is consistent with original content

overall_notes: This paper is primarily about stance detection (an NLU task) using background knowledge augmentation. While it uses generation techniques (ChatGPT) as intermediate steps, the generated outputs are not evaluated as NLG outputs. The human evaluation is conducted on the quality of generated background knowledge used for stance detection, not on evaluating NLG systems.
